official_sources.title: HM Land Registry plans: title plan (practice guide 40, supplement 5)
HM Land Registry plans: the basis of Land Registry plans (practice guide 40, supplement 1)

verified_facts: title plans identify general extent, not exact legal line unless determined
title plans are normally 1:1250 urban or 1:2500 rural
large rural title plans may use 1:5000 or 1:10000
dimensions copied from deeds do not convert a general boundary into an exact boundary
dimension reference points can disappear or change
scaled title-plan measurements can disagree with ground measurements
OS mapping is not intended to represent property boundaries
OS mapping accuracy varies by capture scale and method
1:1250 mapped line width is roughly 0.3m on ground
1:2500 mapped line width is roughly 0.6m on ground
enlarging a map does not improve original positional accuracy
copying reducing or enlarging a plan can distort accuracy
quality_effect: Prevents title-plan scale, deed dimensions or OS basemap depiction from being promoted to exact legal boundary geometry or parcel-height evidence.
